name: BitPay Card
summary: BitPay Card is a prepaid Mastercard that lets you convert crypto to dollars and spend anywhere Mastercard is accepted. Pioneer in crypto payments since 2011. Currently on waitlist as BitPay transitions to a new banking partner.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the BitPay Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$10.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the BitPay Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 3% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the BitPay Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
